zh: 淡水老街！我要去吃阿給、看夕陽。
en: Tamsui Old Street! Agei and the sunset, please.

zh: 漁人碼頭，情人橋的夕陽超美！
en: Fisherman's Wharf — the sunset from Lover's Bridge is gorgeous!

zh: 紅毛城，我們班校外教學在那邊集合。
en: Fort San Domingo — my class field trip meets there.

zh: 新北投，我要去泡溫泉！
en: Xinbeitou — I need a hot-spring soak!

zh: 地熱谷，聽說以前大家在那邊煮溫泉蛋。
en: Thermal Valley — people used to boil eggs in the springs, you know.

zh: 關渡宮，我阿嬤要去拜媽祖。
en: Guandu Temple — my grandma wants to pray to Mazu.

zh: 故宮博物院，我要看翠玉白菜！
en: National Palace Museum — I want to see the Jadeite Cabbage!

zh: 天母，去吃早午餐、逛街。
en: Tianmu, please — brunch and some shopping.

zh: 天母棒球場，今天有比賽！
en: Tianmu Baseball Stadium — there's a game today!

zh: 陽明山花鐘，花季要到了！
en: The Yangmingshan Flower Clock — flower season is here!

zh: 文化後山，載我去看夜景。
en: The PCCU back hill — the night view, please.

zh: 竹子湖，去採海芋！
en: Zhuzihu — calla-lily picking!

zh: 大直美樂華，我要去坐摩天輪！
en: MIRA HAPPY in Dazhi — I want to ride the Ferris wheel!

zh: 忠烈祠，要看衛兵交接。
en: Martyrs' Shrine — I want to see the guard change.

zh: 大直典樺，我要去喝喜酒，快遲到了！
en: The wedding hall in Dazhi — I'm late for a wedding banquet!

zh: 內科，九點要開會，拜託快一點！
en: Neihu Tech Park — I've got a nine o'clock meeting, hurry!

zh: 大湖公園，去看錦帶橋。
en: Dahu Park — I want to see the Jindai arch bridge.

zh: 內湖好事多，我要去搬一整箱衛生紙。
en: Costgo in Neihu — I need a mega pack of toilet paper.

zh: 南港車站，我要搭高鐵南下！
en: Nangang Station — I'm catching the high-speed rail south!

zh: 南港展覽館，電腦展要開幕了！
en: Nangang Exhibition Center — the computer expo is opening!

zh: 北流，今天有演唱會！
en: Taipei Music Center — concert tonight!

zh: 三重三和夜市，去吃大腸麵線。
en: Sanhe Night Market in Sanchong — intestine vermicelli!

zh: 先嗇宮，我要去拜神農大帝。
en: Xianse Temple — I want to pray to the Divine Farmer.

zh: 板橋車站，我要趕火車回南部。
en: Banqiao Station — my train home down south!

zh: 板橋林家花園，我們要拍婚紗。
en: The Lin Family Garden in Banqiao — our wedding photos!

zh: 新北市政府，要去辦事。
en: New Taipei City Hall — some paperwork.

zh: 湳雅夜市，宵夜時間！
en: Nanya Night Market — late-night snack time!

zh: 永和樂華夜市！
en: Lehua Night Market in Yonghe!

zh: 永和，吃燒餅油條配豆漿。
en: Yonghe — soy milk and a flatbread with fried dough!

zh: 中和緬甸街，去吃魚湯麵。
en: Burma Street in Zhonghe — a bowl of mohinga!

zh: 公館，台大旁邊那個夜市。
en: Gongguan — the night market by NTU.

zh: 寶藏巖，去看藝術村。
en: Treasure Hill — the artist village.

zh: 木柵動物園，帶小孩去看貓熊！
en: Taipei Zoo — taking the kids to see the pandas!

zh: 政大，我要去上課。
en: NCCU — I have class.

zh: 貓空，去喝茶看夜景。
en: Maokong — tea and the night view.

zh: 指南宮……聽說情侶去會分手，我是去求財的。
en: Zhinan Temple… they say couples who go break up — I'm praying for money.
